title: Experience Model v6: CompilerGym two-system recipe-feasibility protocol v3
summary: Propose a revised, strictly bounded v6 protocol conditional on unchanged already-local official CompilerGym 0.2.5, LLVM 10, and benchmark://poj104-v1 bytes. HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are the only two on-policy systems. They share the same frozen model/bootstrap, reconstructed ORIENT-to-THINK_ACT packet, common locked acquisition order, ledger, capped notebook/retrieval channel, tools, logical budgets, SLEEP cadence, and reset policy. EXPERIENTIAL alone mounts a null-initialized life-local rank-16 q/v LoRA rebuilt from deterministic outcome-filtered public acquisition rows; HARNESS has no mounted adapter. Both primary systems receive matched sterile target evaluation at checkpoints. Adapter-off and final binding-shuffled variants are EXPERIENTIAL-only sterile diagnostics, not agents. The first pilot contains no anchor, preservation, KL, or auxiliary training rows, so adapter-off is not confounded by a preservation update. Stage C is only a fixed-recipe wiring/feasibility observation, never a mechanism, causal-credit, lifetime, population, superiority, or scientific claim. This proposal authorizes no implementation, inspection, install, import, execution, training, model call, CPU/GPU run, target opening, or claim.
system_thesis: A recurrent agent's auditable working state is a bounded canonical packet reconstructed for every model call. If exactly two otherwise matched on-policy systems act on public LLVM feedback, and only EXPERIENTIAL deterministically compiles its sealed public acquisition records into one life-local LoRA, the immediate question is whether the exact frozen wiring, score, lifecycle, and sterile-fork construction are feasible. Context reconstruction and common nonparametric evidence stores are part of both whole systems. The LoRA is the only adaptive parameter state across sleep; sealed ledger/notebook records are persistent nonparametric source evidence, not learned parameter state. No Stage-C outcome is evidence that the credit rule is causal or that the treatment effect generalizes beyond this one realization.

nodes.before: V2 names two primary systems but does not execute held-out HARNESS measurement at the declared checkpoints and counterbalances a one-pair life by arm.
nodes.after: HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are exactly the two and only two on-policy systems. They use the same frozen base, bootstrap, tokenizer, packet assembler, public task order, public ledger, capped notebook/retriever, tools, six-pair task budget, logical counters, task/life resets, and deterministic SLEEP schedule. A single manifest-locked acquisition order is common to both systems; it is not counterbalancing and yields no arm-effect estimate. At checkpoints 0, 4, and 8, each system cold-starts matched sealed target descendants. Only EXPERIENTIAL additionally has adapter-off at 0/4/8 and final binding-shuffled diagnostics. Forks collect no life and never write back.
nodes.rationale: Adds the missing whole-system measurement without inflating the on-policy core or pretending one pair identifies order or treatment effects.

nodes.before: V2 prohibits hidden state in prose but collapses mounted bytes, telemetry, public/static data, workspace, source records, and forbidden descendants into composite visibility cells.
nodes.after: Every ORIENT and THINK_ACT call reconstructs a canonical capped packet from immutable ANCHOR; harness-owned logical counters; opaque life/task progress; a bounded focus object; compact public ENVIRONMENT; capped common retrieval; and complete recent events. ORIENT always precedes THINK_ACT and may request at most two recalled records. Only finite public operational labels may receive loss: focus_mode, recall_kind, recall_source, operation_type, legal pass identifier, and canonical finite operation arguments. Reason, rationale, strategy prose, active-question prose, hypothesis, prediction, uncertainty, expected effect, free text, and unparsed output are provenance/input-only with mask zero. Mounted adapter bytes, hidden condition labels, infrastructure telemetry, current workspace, cross-boundary ephemeral state, sealed source evidence, target/evaluator data, and training receipts have separate matrix items and explicit readers/writers.
nodes.rationale: Makes prompt state, target authority, and every durable or hidden channel auditable at field and boundary granularity.

nodes.before: V2 calls the writer outcome-grounded, mixes causal-credit language with a post-selection shuffle, and includes fixed preservation/anchor training that confounds authentic-versus-off adapter comparisons.
nodes.after: At sleeps after acquisition tasks 4 and 8, a model-free deterministic compiler reads only EXPERIENTIAL's sealed public acquisition ledger/notebook prefix and forms ORIENT, ACT, and REVISE rows using frozen epsilon, gamma=0.7, rho=0.5, exact deduplication, 192 rows/64 per view, fixed 50:50 old/new replay, frozen ordering/truncation, and assistant loss only on the finite operational fields. Rows are deterministic outcome-filtered supervision, not validated causal credit. No anchor/preservation/KL/instruction auxiliary rows, preservation-only adapter, or other non-acquisition training objective exists in v3. The authentic adapter is a clean-base cumulative rank-16 alpha-16 dropout-0 q_proj/v_proj LoRA rebuild with reset AdamW, 24 target-token touches per retained row, fixed update/token receipt, atomic publication, and destruction of all trainer state. Adapter-off is the null adapter, so it differs from authentic only by the acquisition-derived outcome-filtered writer update.
nodes.rationale: Keeps one learned parameter object while removing the preservation-update confound rather than introducing another control arm.

nodes.before: V2 uses an IrInstructionCount/normalized-reward slash and a prose related/nonduplicate split, leaving metric direction, invalid treatment, strata, spares, and headroom underdefined.
nodes.after: The candidate substrate is unchanged already-local official CompilerGym 0.2.5 with LLVM 10, official benchmark://poj104-v1, public Autophase[56], InstCount[70], current IrInstructionCount, and a canonical ordered legal pass list; raw IR and BitcodeFile paths are not model-visible. The sole reward-space identifier is IrInstructionCountOz. With public audit costs I_0, I_Oz, I_i,j and a valid state, S_i,k=(I_0-min_{j<=k,valid} I_i,j)/(I_0-I_Oz); S_i,k=0 until a valid state exists; G_i=(1/6) sum_{k=1..6} S_i,k. The denominator must be finite and strictly positive; malformed, invalid, timeout, and environment-error operations consume budget, remain separately counted, and retain the earlier valid best; an indeterminate primary cell is not regenerated. Epsilon is the manifest-bound public score resolution measured before targets open. A sealed public-static constructor mechanically canonicalizes source/IR, forms duplicate components from exact/normalized graph/signature/nearest-neighbor rules, then makes four relation groups with two acquisition candidates, one target, and two spares each using the first legal sorted candidates. It records public structural relation and target-blind positive headroom diagnostics; any missing local byte, nonreplayable semantics, invalid split cell, duplicate/neighbor leakage, or absent headroom rejects this substrate without repair or substitution.
nodes.rationale: Turns the benchmark and descriptive scalar into a conditional executable contract before any target or model access.

nodes.before: V2 mixes static inspection, fixtures, implementation, offline install, hardware fit, and pilot execution under ambiguous required-before labels.
nodes.after: This proposed artifact authorizes nothing. One exact human ratification may authorize the full bounded A-through-C program as a single conditional scope: A, non-executing local-byte/static inspection; B1, design and fixture/test implementation; B2, disposable unchanged-install CPU semantic canary and executable harness; B3, hardware/model acquisition-only fixed-recipe canary; then C, the one-pair target wiring/feasibility run after a sealed run manifest and all prior receipts. Transitions are automatic only inside that ratified scope and only after the required independent reviews and machine-verifiable gates pass. Any failed or indeterminate gate stops the program and cannot trigger repair, substitution, tuning, target access, or a new experiment. B3 uses acquisition-only public rows and the exact writer recipe to test row/token-mask, nonzero target-token gradient, fixed updates/touches, numerical status, same-stack receipt tolerance, behavioral cold-load, and schema/style stability; it neither tunes nor opens targets. Stage D and every scientific claim remain outside this scope and require a new change.
nodes.rationale: Separates artifact classes and executable authority while providing the actual-row fixed-recipe fit gate required before target exposure.

edges.before: V2's primary-agent graph has no matched HARNESS target-fork edge and an unatomized packet/visibility representation.
edges.after: Authoritative packet -> ORIENT ContextPlan -> common capped target-blind retrieval -> THINK_ACT one typed operation -> one registered public result -> sealed complete event and harness counter update, identically in both on-policy systems except below-prompt EXPERIENTIAL adapter bytes.
edges.rationale: Binds the two-system comparison to one explicit recurrent invocation path.

edges.before: V2 permits an unexplained preservation objective in the authentic writer and labels temporal eligibility as outcome grounding.
edges.after: Only sealed EXPERIENTIAL acquisition events, declared notebook evidence, public official outcomes, and logical receipts enter the deterministic compiler. Its authentic output writes exactly one LoRA; no target, evaluation descendant, rationale wording, anchor/preservation row, optimizer moment, or auxiliary objective enters the update.
edges.rationale: Restricts the treatment update to declared acquisition-derived supervision.

edges.before: V2 evaluates experiential authentic/off/shuffle forks but omits the corresponding HARNESS checkpoint target descendant.
edges.after: Every sealed checkpoint cold-starts a HARNESS target fork and an EXPERIENTIAL-authentic target fork under the same target packet, six-pair budget, G computation, order, reset, and quarantine. EXPERIENTIAL additionally receives a null adapter-off target fork at each checkpoint and final binding-shuffled adapter fork only after derangement construction passes. Evaluation state cannot reach either life, retriever, compiler, trainer, later target, or split.
edges.rationale: Measures the stated two-system descriptive contrast while retaining secondary treatment diagnostics as sterile forks.

edges.before: V2's shuffle does not distinguish identifier change from semantic disruption and is described as outcome-binding evidence.
edges.after: The final binding-shuffled adapter begins from the authentic selected input rows and finite target multiset. Within a manifest-bound compatible public-state stratum, it cyclically deranges focus/action targets only across different declared semantic equivalence classes. Every shuffled target must differ semantically from its original, every stratum needs at least two eligible members, and row/view/token/update counts remain authentic-identical; otherwise no shuffled cell exists and the recipe feasibility report records control-construction failure. It is only a state-operation-binding diagnostic and leaves outcome-filtered selection unchanged.
edges.rationale: Prevents semantically vacuous shuffling and forbids causal-credit interpretation.

edges.before: V2 makes local fit necessary but does not state which artifact authority is necessary before static, CPU, canary, or Stage-C work.
edges.after: Only passing hash/static fit, atomized fixture/lifecycle tests, offline semantics and split seal, acquisition-only fixed-recipe fit, independent review, and the exact ratified run manifest may open the next listed stage within the single A-through-C authorization. A failure terminates this substrate or recipe; it is never a reason to patch, substitute, sweep, tune, or reveal targets.
edges.rationale: Prevents scope escalation from a passing design document or partial receipt.

loops.before: V2 specifies a wake loop but permits unenumerated typed focus prose as a possible target and does not bind the common locked order across the two primary systems.
loops.after: For each available decision in the shared locked task order, reconstruct the capped packet from only declared authoritative fields; call the same base/bootstrap/tokenizer/sampling family in ORIENT; parse-or-charge a bounded ContextPlan; materialize at most two common retrieval results; reconstruct the THINK_ACT packet; parse-or-charge one operation; execute one registered public operation; append one complete public event; and charge harness-owned counters. ORIENT cannot act; THINK_ACT cannot bypass packet/retrieval. Finite focus_mode and recall enums may be assistant targets. All prose fields, including reason, rationale, strategy, question, hypothesis, prediction, uncertainty, expected effect and unparsed output, are mask-zero. Both systems receive six ORIENT/THINK_ACT pairs, 4,096 input tokens/call, at most 256 output tokens/call, a 512-token complete-event tail, and at most 3,072 generated tokens/task.
loops.trigger: Every acquisition or sterile evaluation decision until STOP, terminal public state, or the declared budget is consumed.
reads: current public observation and legal action projection
mounted treatment adapter only where assigned below prompt assembly
loops.stop_condition: STOP, terminal public state, malformed/invalid charge as specified, or fixed decision/call/token/action budget exhaustion; no hidden retry, chat, prefix/KV, scheduler, cache, or provider session survives a call.
loops.rationale: Preserves one recurrent model while closing target-mask and hidden-state routes.

loops.before: V2 conflicts over whether source evidence persists across sleep and combines compile determinism with trainer-byte determinism.
loops.after: Only after common acquisition task boundaries 4 and 8, seal EXPERIENTIAL's ledger/notebook prefix, compile the exact outcome-filtered corpus, clean-base train the one authentic LoRA with reset optimizer and no preservation objective, atomically publish only on receipt success, and destroy trainer process, optimizer, gradients, data/cache, packed batches, temporary corpus, inference processes, and KV. HARNESS performs the same scheduling and accounting but mounts no adapter and has no useful sham bytes. Within a life, the sealed ledger, bounded notebook, retrieval index definition, immutable manifest and receipt persist as nonparametric source/audit evidence; only the authentic LoRA is adaptive parameter state across sleep. At task boundary focus, tail, workspace, environment, task tools/files, task RNG, compiler/cache and process state reset; at life boundary adapter, sources, indices, counters, files, caches, RNG lineage and all progress reset.
loops.trigger: Only after acquisition tasks 4 and 8 in the ratified Stage-C schedule; no target or evaluation event can trigger it.

loops.stop_condition: Atomic receipt success or a schema/provenance/mask/budget/numerical/integrity failure that seals the exact recipe failed with no retry, sweep, or repair.
loops.rationale: Separates persistent source evidence from learned state and makes training reproducibility claims testable by tier.

loops.before: V2 omits a HARNESS target fork and describes a one-life pilot with mechanism language.
loops.after: At checkpoints 0, 4, and 8, cold-start HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL-authentic target descendants from their independently evolving sealed histories. Each target uses the same sealed public packet, fixed target order, six wake pairs, G score, logical budget, reset and quarantine. At each experiential checkpoint separately cold-start adapter-off from its base/null assignment; at checkpoint 8 cold-start binding-shuffled only if semantic derangement succeeds. Descendants contain no life retrieval store, receive no condition/checkpoint/telemetry marker, and are destroyed after their target; raw target outcomes, artifacts and logs never return to either life.

loops.stop_condition: Six pairs, STOP, terminal task, or declared failure, followed by mandatory teardown and non-return of every descendant state.
loops.rationale: Measures the two-system whole-harness wiring under equal target conditions without creating extra acquiring systems.

claims.before: V2 permits one paired life to be called a short-horizon outcome-grounded mechanism observation.
claims.after: A Stage-C report can say only whether this exact frozen two-system wiring, unchanged substrate, score, lifecycle, fixed recipe, and sterile fork construction were feasible, failed, or were indeterminate in one realization. Its primary descriptive quantity is D_HE,c=mean_i(G_EXPERIENTIAL,i,c-G_HARNESS,i,c) for each checkpoint c in {0,4,8}; D_off,c and final D_shuf are secondary diagnostics. Common order, one life, nested targets, and one trainer/inference realization do not estimate an arm effect, validate the outcome-filter heuristic, or establish a mechanism.
claims.evidence_needed: All prior stage receipts, raw cell-level ledgers, matched HARNESS/EXPERIENTIAL checkpoint targets, exact score receipts, visibility/lifecycle evidence, semantic-shuffle construction receipt, and a report limited to recipe feasibility.

claims.before: V2 forbids rationale endpoints but leaves reason/strategy/question/uncertainty/expected-effect targetability ambiguous.
claims.after: No raw private thought, unparsed output, rationale, reason, strategy prose, active-question prose, hypothesis, prediction, uncertainty, expected-effect prose, self-report, or human-theory similarity is a correctness label, endpoint, promotion criterion, or positive target. Only explicitly enumerated finite public operational fields and legal operation arguments receive loss; every other text token has mask zero. Public outcome and typed-operation metrics are the only Stage-C evidence channels.
claims.evidence_needed: Canonical packet/schema fixtures, token-level mask ledger, metric audit, and offline endpoint audit showing no prohibited field reaches a loss-one token or score.

claims.before: The motivating lifetime, outcome-credit, and external-memory comparison can be read into v2's pilot language.
claims.after: This proposal cannot establish consciousness, creativity, abstraction, general intelligence, causal outcome credit, LoRA superiority, external-memory superiority, baseline saturation, flywheel compounding, post-context growth, population effects, or paper evidence. Those require a separate Stage-D change with fresh tasks, multiple independent paired lives, life-level uncertainty and order handling, post-context checkpoints, direct outcome-selection intervention, and same-corpus text/raw-LoRA/wrong-life/organized-memory controls.
claims.evidence_needed: A separately ratified Stage-D preregistration, independent review, new bound run manifest, and evidence from independent lives rather than the Stage-C cells.

acceptance_tests.setup: Static canonical fixtures cover every ORIENT/THINK_ACT reconstruction, exact 4,096/512/256/2/6 caps, parser charge path, finite focus/recall/operation labels, and all retained prose fields.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only canonical fields are reachable; ORIENT cannot act; THINK_ACT cannot bypass retrieval; malformed output charges once; only enumerated public operational tokens have mask one; reason/rationale/strategy/question/hypothesis/prediction/uncertainty/expected-effect/free text/unparsed output have mask zero; no second model, scheduler, chat, KV, prefix or free-form state exists.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The explicit recurrent-state, one-model, no-private-thought target, or bounded grammar contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: Golden sealed public ledgers cover immediate improvement, delayed setup, failure/recovery, invalid calls, ties, replay, truncation, rejected rows, every loss subfield, and final selected-row semantic derangement.
acceptance_tests.expected: Candidate/credit/row/mask/order/corpus manifests are byte-identical from identical inputs; invalid actions get no positive ACT credit; all prose is mask zero; no anchor/preservation/KL/auxiliary row exists; compile bytes are exact; training receipt requires a pinned same-stack numerical tolerance; behavioral cold-load is evaluated separately; retries or platform-dependent reclassification fail sealed. Shuffle preserves authentic budgets and passes only when every target is semantically disrupted.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Writer authority, absence of preservation confound, token-mask boundary, determinism-tier contract, or binding-diagnostic construction.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fixture boundaries exercise call, task, sleep, life, crash and each sterile fork with explicit file/process/cache/RNG/workspace allowlists and base-plus-assigned-adapter replay.
acceptance_tests.expected: Sealed ledger/notebook/immutable receipts persist only as declared common nonparametric within-life source evidence; the treatment LoRA alone is adaptive parameter state across sleep; trainer/optimizer/gradient/cache/process/KV/task workspace/RNG and evaluation descendants reset; cold load behavior reproduces the assigned authentic/null/shuffled condition under the declared tolerance; no HARNESS adapter is mounted.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Boundary isolation, adapter attribution, source-versus-learned-state distinction, or fork sterility.

acceptance_tests.setup: Verify the full atomic matrix and diff model-visible bytes/counters on matched public histories across HARNESS, EXPERIENTIAL, and all four named target forks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly the declared readers/writers exist: mounted adapter bytes are distinct from condition labels; current workspace is distinct from forbidden carryover; public static metadata is distinct from target/reference data; receipts/telemetry are distinct from packet fields. HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL target forks have identical public packet/budget/order/reset rules. No arm, condition, checkpoint, adapter origin, row count, latency, cache warmth, retry, training duration, target role, hidden evaluator, or private-thought cue is visible to a model.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Visibility noninterference, full-harness parity, or the missing HARNESS checkpoint estimand.

The exact G formula, denominator rule, epsilon source, invalid/missing rule, m=max(0.05,2*s_canary) default, first sorted group/spare selection, duplicate/near-neighbor exclusions and target-blind positive headroom reports are bindable. Any unavailable, altered, unhashable, duplicate, no-headroom or no-spare condition rejects this substrate without repair/substitution.
